Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.aws.auth

Class SigV4Signer

java.lang.Object
eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.aws.auth.SigV4Signer
public final class SigV4Signer extends Object
Signs HTTP requests with AWS Signature Version 4, for the AWS APIs the runtime calls itself (e.g. SQS) without the AWS SDK. Follows the AWS SigV4 specification; the unit tests check it against the official test suite.

  • Method Details

    • sign

      public static Map<String,String> sign(String method, URI uri, Map<String,String> headers, byte[] body, String service, String region, AwsCredentials credentials, Instant now)
      Computes the headers that sign a request.
      Parameters:
      method - the HTTP method
      uri - the request URI (path and query are signed)
      headers - the headers that are sent and signed, without host and x-amz-date, which are added
      body - the request body, empty for none
      service - the service signing name, e.g. sqs
      region - the region, e.g. eu-central-1
      credentials - the credentials
      now - the time of the request
      Returns:
      the headers to add: Host, X-Amz-Date, X-Amz-Security-Token (temporary credentials) and Authorization

    • signS3

      public static Map<String,String> signS3(String method, URI uri, Map<String,String> headers, byte[] body, String region, AwsCredentials credentials, Instant now)
      Computes the headers that sign an S3 request. S3 signs the path as it is sent, without encoding it a second time, and needs the header x-amz-content-sha256, which is added.
      Parameters:
      method - the HTTP method
      uri - the request URI, with the object key encoded per segment
      headers - the headers that are sent and signed
      body - the request body, empty for none
      region - the region
      credentials - the credentials
      now - the time of the request
      Returns:
      the headers to add, as sign(java.lang.String, java.net.URI, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String>, byte[], java.lang.String, java.lang.String, eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.aws.auth.AwsCredentials, java.time.Instant) returns them, and X-Amz-Content-Sha256
